about_the_game:
Titanic: Honor & Glory aims to re-create the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin. The ship will be fully explorable in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible. This recreation is situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard. The end goal for this project, as it has always been, is to recreate the Titanic in its entirety.

The THG Alpha is being constructed!

We have been working on a way to allow our fans, supporters, and enthusiasts to explore our Titanic recreation as it's being built. In a continuation of the vision we had for THG back in 2021, but in a way that's more appropriate for the way we're building the ship and the stage this process is at, the Titanic: Honor & Glory Alpha will be set in the shipyard at Belfast! Explore our virtual Titanic as we build it, in the gantry, in a recreation of the yard where it all came to be! And the best part? You'll be able to do so for free!

What are some things you'll be able to see and do in this Alpha?

Visit the Titanic as she was built, with the ability to walk her unfinished decks and climb around the structure. As we continue to develop the ship, additional elements will be added in future updates, allowing players to experience it firsthand.

Explore the yard where Titanic was built, including the massive Arrol Gantry. Climb the stairs, walk the catwalks, meander the platforms. Use it to access Titanic's structure or climb it for incredible views of the ship.

Check out places like the Platers' Shed and the Cabinet Shop, facilities that were used to prepare the ship's steel plating and build furnishings. These areas will be used to display structural elements and other large objects relevant to the ship, as well as smaller fittings and furnishings, acting as museum-like spaces for players to learn more about various aspects of Titanic and to see what we're working on long before it's put on the ship.

Hop over to the Main Offices (in their 1912/1913 form), including the two famous drawing rooms. Here you'll be able to see plans in the drawing rooms or visit areas like the cozy Consultation Room, where you'll find information on THG and our process for building the ship.

Set the time of day to your liking! Day mode, night mode– ANY time you want!

Change the weather to whatever suits you, from rain and snow to foggy, cloudy, or clear days! Run around Titanic's towering structure as it snows, or relax and soak up the vibes on a rainy day at the shipyard.

Experience a world alive with the men who built Titanic! Builders and foremen walking about and working on the ship, designers in the offices!

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX12 support
  • Sound Card: Any

Recommended:
  • OS: 10 or 11
  • Processor: Dual core CPU
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with DirectX12 support
  • Sound Card: Any
